title: diphasiastrum complanatum subsp. alpinum
intro: Diphasiastrum complanatum subsp. alpinum, commonly known as the Alpinum Lycopod or Alpines Ground Pine, is a subspecies of plant in the club moss family (Lycopodiaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Diphasiastrum complanatum subsp. alpinum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may have antimicrobial and antiviral effects as well.
